result.quote: So the old prophet lifted up the body of the man of God, laid it on the donkey, and brought it back to his own city to mourn for him and bury him.
result.reason: The window supports that the old prophet finds the body, but it never says that he saddles a donkey or that he has just heard men. It also describes several later actions—lifting the body, laying it on the donkey, bringing it back, mourning, and burying—so the vague wording “What does ... do” does not uniquely elicit the keyed response. “After hearing men” is also unnatural and unspecified.
